source.name: Football Shirt Culture: Argentina 2026 Adidas Home Kit
source.quote: Adidas has unveiled the new Argentina 2026 Home Kit, created in partnership with the Argentine Football Association (AFA)
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. FSC's launch description covers every mark on the shirt: 'the AFA crest sits proudly with three gold stars', appearing 'alongside the FIFA World Champions badge and the adidas logo, both in gold', '1893' on the back of the collar; the full kit is dark blue shorts and matching socks with light blue and white trim. The launch photos show the shirt front, back and shorts: no commercial sponsor on any placement.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: adidas's 2026 home shirt (traditional white and sky blue stripes with three tonal shades of blue) carries only the AFA crest with three gold stars, the FIFA World Champions badge and the adidas logo in gold; the launch description and photos show plain sleeves and dark blue adidas-trimmed shorts (Football Shirt Culture's launch description and images).
